name: Sentry OG social card — mascot debugging vignette by sentry.io
description: A 1200×630 social card built as a triptych: skeleton product vignettes (Replays and Traces timelines) bleed off the left edge, an oversized flat-vector robot fills the centre, and an AI-diagnosis card bleeds off the right. Two light beams — hot magenta from the character's ray gun toward the left panels, neon lime from its handheld scanner toward the right panel — act as focal connectors, so the mascot literally illuminates the product UI it is debugging. The deep purple-black canvas carries saturated magenta/purple character art and reserves a single lime accent for headings and key UI spans, with white bold sans headings and small icon-chipped event lines adding technical texture.
